parts.name: Left finger — Generalist yellow, mirror of the right
Left rack — black, one print with the left handle (both hooks, strap tunnel, tail and hub): the bottom rack, up its outboard arm
Right rack — black, one print with the right handle (both hooks, strap tunnel, tail and hub): the top rack
Pinion — black, the one gear: centred, bolted to the motor flange with 3 M3, drives both racks
Base — black plate under the pinion and racks, a groove for each rack's tongue, 2 M3 to the motor
Motor — RobStride RS00, reference only (not printed)
